title: ALLEXCEPT removes the filters on the table except those on the listed column
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALLEXCEPT ( 'Product', 'Product'[Category] ) ) ), 'Product'[Product] = "Helmet", 'Product'[Category] = "Accessories" )

source.quote: ALLEXCEPT removes the filters from the expanded table specified in the first argument, keeping only the filters in the columns specified in the following arguments
source.supports: ALLEXCEPT as a modifier removes the filters of the table, keeping those on the listed columns

derivation: Outer filters: Product = Helmet (60) and Category = Accessories. ALLEXCEPT removes the filter on Product[Product] and keeps Category = Accessories: Helmet 60 + Lock 80 = 140.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
